long: Total Overdose: A Gunslinger's Tale in Mexico is an over-the-top third-person action shooter set in a stylized Mexican border world. Players chain stunts, slow-motion dives, and combo kills as agent Ram Cruz to rack up score in an open environment. It was developed by Deadline Games and published by Eidos Interactive.
name: Total Overdose: A Gunslinger's Tale in Mexico
short: Total Overdose: A Gunslinger's Tale in Mexico (Deadline Games 2005, via Proton)
